Sentence (English): Thoughtful features for optimal durability.
Comments (English): I was thinking about whether to buy a dishwasher or a dryer after moving. I was able to use it as a good opportunity. The colors are just my taste in black and white. It is neat and simple. The size is bigger than I thought. First of all, it was good because it was self-installation and easy to install. The standard took about an hour and the fast took about 30 minutes. However, it may be a little inconvenient because it doesn't dry. There is no separate drying function. You have to use the standard to finish drying. After finishing, you have to leave the door open. There is no auto-opening function. Since it is cheap, there is no choice~~ It washes well with steam sterilization. The operating noise is loud, but it is a new world. The size is just right for a family of two. When there are not many dishes, it is sometimes a little ambiguous to use. I wonder how much the electricity bill will be if I think about running it for 1 hour on the standard basis. I wash dishes in hot water for grease, but now I don't have to worry about grease anymore. Fact check. From messy sauce to stuck-on rice to grease that can't be cleaned, it's a 72-hour ventilation circulation system product that dries and safely stores everything at once. The fan inside improves the drying function, and the airflow generated for 72 hours removes moisture and odor, allowing you to store dishes easily without separate organization. Moisture/odor fan operation cycle Standard, strong mode (not fast mode) 72 High temperature water to clean grease stains Midea 72 degrees Celsius high temperature washing Grease removal Check with your own eyes to see if it is cleaned cleanly! No other functions are needed. 5 practical washing modes With various washing modes that only contain the functions you need, leave the dishwasher to wash the dishes and spend your time leisurely! 5 washing modes Standard Strong Eco Fast Don't worry about water overflowing! Automatic water level recognition sensor When the water tank inside is full, the water level is automatically notified. Fill the water before using the dishwasher and select the course. Space-saving design No drilling or installation anywhere Water supply is available without restrictions on the side or upper space, so you can use it anywhere without inconvenience. If the water supply drainage is possible, use it without space restrictions. You can use it anywhere, under the sink or under the upper cabinet. Even though it is small, it can hold a lot. Storage space optimized for 2~3 households. Don't put off the annoying dishwashing and leave it to the dishwasher with the dish storage space optimized for 2~3 person households. Sentence (English): It's only been two days, but I've got a dishwashing routine.
Comments (English): [ The world is so comfortable. ] || ---------------- || It's only been two days, but I've got a dishwashing routine. I pour a cup of coffee, put it on the table, go to the sink, turn on the water in the dishwasher (if you use a Javara faucet, it might be easier to use it with a drip tray). It takes more than a minute to pour the water, so you can do some pre-washing in the meantime. I stack the dishes in Tetris mode, add detergent, and press the start button. They say to put in 6 grams of detergent, but I use a 10-gram all-in-one detergent in half. Strictly speaking, it's only 5 grams, but whatever. I guess that difference doesn't matter, because it washes well. Then I wash the sink strainer once, wipe the sink, and wipe the table. After I finish cleaning up, the coffee has cooled to a temperature that's perfect for drinking. After I drink a cup of coffee, the dishwashing machine starts. (It seems like it takes a long time to get ready.) Then I press the pause button and put the cup I used to drink coffee in, and that's it. Then I just open the door, organize the dishes, and put them in. On days when there were a lot of dishes, I used to feel a little tired after washing them, but now I feel like I have more free time. Buy a dishwasher. You should definitely buy one.
Comments (Original): [ 세상 편하네요. ] || ---------------- || 이제 겨우 이틀째지만ㅎ 설거지 루틴이 생겼어요.  커피 한잔 내려서 식탁에 올려두고 싱크대로 가서 식기세척기에 물을 틀어두고요 (자바라 수전 쓰시는 분들은 물받이 끼워두고 쓰시는게 편할듯)  물 받는 시간이 1분 이상은 걸리기 때문에 그 사이에 애벌 설거지 가능하고요.  그릇 적당히 테트리스해서 쌓아두고 세제를 넣고 시작 버튼을 눌러요.  세제는 6그램 넣으라고 하는데요. 저는 10그램짜리 올인원 세제 반 잘라서 써요.  따지고 들면 5그램이겠지만 뭐.. 그정도 차이는 상관없는지 잘 씻깁니다. 그리고 싱크대 거름망 한번 씻어주고, 싱크대 닦고, 식탁 닦고. 뒷정리 다하면 커피가 딱 마시기 좋은 온도로 식어 있어요.  그렇게 커피 한잔 마시고 나면  세척이 시작되고 있거든요. (가동 준비 시간이 좀 긴듯)  거기서 일시정시 버튼 누르고 커피 마신 컵 넣으면 오늘 설거지는 끝이죠. 그리고 나중에 도어만 열어주고 그릇만 정리해서 넣으면 돼요. 그릇 많이 나온 날은 설거지 하고나면 살짝 지치곤 했는데 그런것도 없고ㅎ 시간 여유가 생겼다는게 체감이 돼요.  식세기 사세요. 꼭 사세요.

Sentence (English): I sent a Samsung Bespoke as a gift, and I felt great throughout the installation process.
Comments (English): [ So pretty ] || ---------------- || I sent a Samsung Bespoke as a gift, and I felt great throughout the installation process. First off, the design is so pretty. The color feels more like a slight gray tint rather than pure white. I chose white to match my water purifier, and while it does clash a bit, I consoled myself by saying it matched the wallpaper. Two technicians came to install it, and they did a fantastic job. If you are debating between the 12-person and 12-person models, I recommend the 6-person model for households of three or fewer. My family is three people and uses the 12-person model, but since the daily output is small, we end up running it after accumulating water for a couple of days. As a result, it feels a bit more shabby. The family I gifted it to is also a family of three with a baby, so the 6-person model seems to be the perfect fit.
Comments (Original): [ 너무이쁨 ] || ---------------- || 선물로 삼성비스포크 보냈는데설치내내 기분이 너무 좋았음.일단 디자인이 너무이쁨ㅎㅎ색은 화이트라기보단 그레이빛 살짝 섞인느낌?정수기랑 맞춰주려고 화이트선택한건데 약간 따로놀긴 하지만 벽지랑 맞춤했다고 위안삼음.설치기사님이 두분오셔서 너무 잘해주셨음.혹시12인용이랑 고민하시는분은 3인이하 가정은 6인용을 추천함.우리집은 3인가정 12인용인데 아무래도 하루에 나오는양이 적으니 한이틀 모아서 작동하게됨.그러니 더 지지한 느낌^^;;;선물한 집도 아기랑 3인가정이라 6인용이 딱인듯함.

Sentence (English): I have to say, my new dishwasher, the WDT730HAMZ, is like the James Bond of kitchen appliances - suave, sophisticated, and has a license to thrill.
Comments (English): [ Quiet, Quirky, and Quality Cleaning ] || ---------------- || I have to say, my new dishwasher, the WDT730HAMZ, is like the James Bond of kitchen appliances - suave, sophisticated, and has a license to thrill. Or maybe I should say it has a license to "dish-appoint" because it's got a few quirks that make me scratch my head while still managing to leave me impressed. First things first, this thing is so quiet that it's like it's trying to out-stealth a ninja. I can't hear it working its magic at all, which is both eerie and kinda cool. You'll find yourself double-checking to make sure it's even running. Speaking of running, this dishwasher takes its sweet time. I swear, it's got a personal motto: "Clean dishes, but take your time doing it." It's like the Dalai Lama of dishwashers, preaching patience and serenity. But hey, it gets the job done, so I can't complain too much. Plasticware lovers, rejoice! I'm not sure what kind of wizardry is at play here, but plastic items come out of this machine drier than the Sahara Desert. It's like they've been sunbathing in the Gobi desert, and I can finally put them away without fear of creating a mini plastic ocean in my cabinets. The third rack is a bit of a mystery, though. It's like the tiny VIP section in a crowded club – only the super flat utensils make it past the velvet rope. Spatulas and serving spoons, sadly, get denied entry. It's like the bouncer has a strict no-bendy-or-curvy-utensils policy. I'm still trying to figure out its purpose, but it's nice to have the option, even if it's a tad exclusive. The top-mounted controls are a nice touch. However, there's one tiny quibble – it's so darn quiet that sometimes I wonder if it's still running. A little indicator light or a polite "I'm still washing! " notification would be helpful. Oh, and here's a small annoyance: if you do open it mid-cycle, you have to hit that "resume" button. It's like a passive-aggressive reminder that you interrupted its Zen moment. Not a deal-breaker, but I do wish it had an "Oops, my bad" setting. Overall, the WDT730HAMZ is a fantastic dishwasher. It's got quirks, but so do we all, right? And the fact that I'm taking the time to write this review should tell you something. If you're looking for a quiet, thorough, and occasionally sassy dishwasher, this one's a winner. Just remember, it dances to its own rhythm – so embrace the leisurely dishwashing lifestyle, my friends!

Sentence (English): I purchased this dishwasher after researching the brand and reading positive reviews online.
Comments (English): [ So far So Good ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher after researching the brand and reading positive reviews online. This was purchased to replace a dishwasher that failed us after 3 years. The installation was easy, and we have run a few cycles and it is working fine so far. The features are all standard, but for the price point it is on the upper range. We hope this lasts longer than our previous brand, which we paid slightly less for, and think was a better dishwasher despite failing. The previous brand only lasted 3 years after it started leaking profusely from the front door gasket and repairs did not work. In comparison, the Bosch baskets and control functions seem of less quality compared to the other dishwasher we had, which we were content with until the problems started. It is also slightly louder than the previous model, rated at 44dba, our other model was 39db and that one was hardly noticeable. The red indicator light is helpful to know the dishwasher is running, but I wish it was easier to see how much time was left without having to open the door. Despite the few negatives in comparison to the other dishwasher, we are hoping it can be reliable and last us longer than our previous model. The stainless steel is a nice touch, but I also think it will be harder to maintain than a fingerprint resistant finsih like some other brands offer.

Sentence (English): I purchased this dishwasher after researching the brand and reading positive reviews online.
Comments (English): [ So far So Good ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher after researching the brand and reading positive reviews online. This was purchased to replace a dishwasher that failed us after 3 years. The installation was easy, and we have run a few cycles and it is working fine so far. The features are all standard, but for the price point it is on the upper range. We hope this lasts longer than our previous brand, which we paid slightly less for, and think was a better dishwasher despite failing. The previous brand only lasted 3 years after it started leaking profusely from the front door gasket and repairs did not work. In comparison, the Bosch baskets and control functions seem of less quality compared to the other dishwasher we had, which we were content with until the problems started. It is also slightly louder than the previous model, rated at 44dba, our other model was 39db and that one was hardly noticeable. The red indicator light is helpful to know the dishwasher is running, but I wish it was easier to see how much time was left without having to open the door. Despite the few negatives in comparison to the other dishwasher, we are hoping it can be reliable and last us longer than our previous model.The stainless steel is a nice touch, but I also think it will be harder to maintain than a fingerprint resistant finsih like some other brands offer.

Overall, previous reviews of this brand as it entered the market were mixed, I consider the purchase and use 5 Stars so far. I have owned it for just under 3 years.

Sentence (English): OMG, Control board issues.
Comments (English): [ Works OK when it works. ] || ---------------- || OMG, Control board issues. Simply Google control board and GE and you will find these their dishwashers last about 3-4 years (warranty is only 1 year on them for a reason). I had to flip the breaker to "reset it" every now and then to get it to power back up. Eventually after a few months, the control board gave up the ghost. I can give GE a break on lack luster drying in a $350 dishwasher (as they are meeting EnergyStar requirements). But the control board should last longer than a few years. Now I have to spend $100 for a new control board and hope it lasts. Many commenters indicate they only get a year or so out the replacement boards. Or, go buy a different brand rip the GE out and put in a new one with all the costs that go along with replacing it. Such a shame it didn't last longer. GE, there's no need to contact me unless someone is offering to replace the board.

Comments (English): [ Great product, terrible purchase experience ] || ---------------- || After purchasing this dishwasher in mid-June 2023 and experiencing a damaged product with the first delivery/install attempt, the dishwasher was finally delivered and installed in late August 2023 and works fine. The second installer was professional and did a great job, although he worked alone and clearly had more appointments than he should have had that day. It was also 95 degrees outside the day the second installer delivered the dishwasher alone. I purchased this dishwasher through Costco because it included delivery, installation, and haul-away of the old dishwasher. The good - the product + the installers: 1. The dishwasher works well and does a decent job 2. Both the first and second installers were professional and did a good job with installation (the first installer re-installed our previous dishwasher when he discovered the product was damaged) The bad - damaged 1st product, long waits with back-orders, poor Costco Customer Service communication: 1. It was a month wait for the first delivery/installation 2. The first dishwasher was damaged and needed to be replaced 3. It was more than a month wait for the second delivery/installation 4. The 1st second delivery date was a no-call, no-show 5. There was no communication from the install company for the 1st no-call, no-show. Instead, I made several calls to the installer in an attempt to get a rescheduled delivery date and time 6. The 2nd second delivery time was a no-call, no-show. I again contacted the install company who said the installer was running behind schedule. 7. Customer Service communication prior to the second delivery/installation was confusing. At one point, they appeared to renege on the installation and instead offered us compensation toward an installer that I could hire. However after contacting Customer Service, they discovered they had made an error as my original order included installation 8. I received no Customer Service follow up or compensation as promised after the undamaged product was finally delivered and installed I have been a member of Costco for years and am disappointed with this purchase experience but not the product. The only follow-up I have received to date is an automated customer satisfaction survey. I did attempt to reach Costco via my Customer Service ticket for this product, however the service record was closed since the installation has been recorded as complete. I am still a Costco member and do not have plans to end my membership. However, when it comes to future appliance purchases, I will most certainly consider alternatives to Costco based on my recent experience.

Sentence (English): I bought my dishwasher in July of 2022.
Comments (English): [ Beware of DOOR and MELTING WHEELS ] || ---------------- || I bought my dishwasher in July of 2022. We had problems right after the dishwasher was installed with the suspension of the door. It was falling straight to the floor when we would open it. It turned out that the Lowes installer who installed it drove a screw into one of the roller wheels on which the suspension cord is threaded! This was the fault of the Lowes installer from MegaPlumbing, so we had to contact MegaPlumbing to get the problem fixed. Some months later, a black rubbery type material started falling from the section that is below the door (in front of the kick plate). The "mat" reminds me more of fake leather they use on the bottom soles of some shoes. It is stiff and mine cracked off a bit at a time. They had to replace the entire outside panel of the dishwasher door in order to replace the sound damping material on the back side of the stainless steel panel.In addition, all of the roller wheels fell off the lower rack and MELTED, so they needed to be replaced. This happened because the roller carriers that are supposed to hold the wheels in place are also really shoddy.Finally, right after the one year warranty of the dishwasher expired, the dishwasher door became misaligned and when it is full opened, it slopes downward instead of being flat and horizontal. I just had the displeasure of dealing with a horrible repair person sent by ASSURANT who manages Lowes' Protection Plans. They didn't even diagnose the problem or try to fix it.ASSURANT provides terrible service! Beware of Lowes' Protection Plans. Read all of the terms and conditions. ASSURANT outsources repairs to the worst service companies.I am tired of problems with the DOOR of this machine and the WHEELS of the lower rack!

Sentence (English): This is a genuine review based on my own purchase!
Comments (English): [ I also tried the test when I was sick and I was impressed^_^ ] || ---------------- || This is a genuine review based on my own purchase! I am leaving this review because I am so satisfied with using the dishwasher. #Appearance and Size. I was surprised by how big it was, bigger than I expected. You will need to make sure you have enough space! Since it is large, the interior is spacious, making it very convenient to use. We are a family of five—two adults and three children—and it is perfect for running it twice a day along with baby bottles. On days when we have a feast, we sometimes run it twice a day. The exterior is very sleek; it doesn't detract from the interior, and since there is no dish drying rack, the kitchen looks clean and tidy. #Cleaning Power and User Review. I was skeptical about how good the cleaning power would be, so I put a lid from an electric rice cooker, which was full of stubborn grime, into it. I ran it on high power without soaking it in water, and wow. It came off completely, sparkling clean. I didn't realize it when washing just dishes, but putting in the grime was truly amazing. I am extremely satisfied with this alone. (I heard that cleaning power varies greatly depending on the detergent, but I used a budget-friendly I&Us detergent by cutting it in half.) I love that I can turn it on after meals and play with the kids or do other housework. #Con. I wish there was a separate drying function. I couldn't immediately organize the kids' daycare trays or dishes. While the powerful drying setting does dry them to some extent, there were parts that didn't dry depending on the position or angle, so I wished there was a separate drying function.
